mapper.select: select id, user_id, department_id, joined_at, status, created_at, updated_at from club_member where user_id = #{userId} limit 1

select u.id as user_id, u.username, u.nickname, d.id as department_id, d.name as department_name, cm.joined_at, cm.status, case when dl.id is null then false else true end as department_leader from club_member cm inner join app_user u on u.id = cm.user_id inner join department d on d.id = cm.department_id left join department_leader dl on dl.user_id = cm.user_id and dl.department_id = cm.department_id where cm.user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into club_member (user_id, department_id, status) values (#{userId}, #{departmentId}, #{status}) on duplicate key update department_id = values(department_id), status = values(status), joined_at = case when status = 'REMOVED' then current_timestamp else joined_at end
